using CUDA
import JSON3

function initstacks_relu_field_b(i_n)
    branch_stack = Vector{Int64}(undef, div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1)
    return branch_stack
end

function cuda_kernel_relu_field_b_1!(branch_stack, i_n, u, v)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    if u[i_x] > 0.0
        branch_stack[(i_x - 1) + 1] = 1
        v[i_x] = u[i_x] ^ 2
    else
        branch_stack[(i_x - 1) + 1] = 0
        v[i_x] = 0.0
    end
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_relu_field_b_2!(branch_stack, i_n, u, ub, vb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    __branch = branch_stack[(i_x - 1) + 1]
    if __branch == 1
        ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + (2 * u[i_x]) * vb[i_x]
        vb[i_x] = 0.0
    else
        vb[i_x] = 0.0
    end
    return nothing
end

function relu_field_b_cuda(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, i_n, branch_stack)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_relu_field_b_1!(branch_stack, i_n, u, v)
    for i_seq_x = 1:i_n
        loss[1] = loss[1] + v[i_seq_x]
    end
    for i_seq_x = i_n:-1:1
        vb[i_seq_x] = vb[i_seq_x] + lossb[1]
    end
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_relu_field_b_2!(branch_stack, i_n, u, ub, vb)
    return nothing
end

function run_cuda()
    u_h = Float64[1.5, -2.0, 0.3, -0.1, 4.0, -3.3, 0.0, 2.2]
    n = length(u_h)

    u = CuArray(u_h)
    v = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n)
    loss = CuArray(Float64[0.0])
    lossb = CuArray(Float64[1.0])
    ub = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n)
    vb = CUDA.zeros(Float64, n)
    branch_stack = CuArray(initstacks_relu_field_b(n))

    relu_field_b_cuda(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, n, branch_stack)
    CUDA.synchronize()

    ub_h = Array(ub)
    expected = Float64[3.0, 0.0, 0.6, 0.0, 8.0, 0.0, 0.0, 4.4]
    max_err = maximum(abs.(ub_h .- expected))

    return Dict(
        "device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())),
        "u" => u_h,
        "ub_gpu" => ub_h,
        "ub_expected_cpu" => expected,
        "max_abs_err" => max_err,
        "match" => max_err < 1e-10,
    )
end

result = run_cuda()
println(JSON3.write(result))
